100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On September 19, 1926, the United States celebrated the successful launch of the first transcontinental radio broadcast, connecting listeners from coast to coast. In Europe, political tensions escalated as the British government faced opposition over its handling of the General Strike, with labor unrest spreading across the continent. Meanwhile, in the Far East, Japan continued to strengthen its military presence in Manchuria, raising concerns among neighboring countries.
